appearance.summary: Before Thracian Primaris (Malleus) he was tall, handsome and well built, though not quite as tall as Eisenhorn, with long black hair tied back in a ponytail from a high-cheekboned, finely sculpted face. After the Lightning crash burned his whole body he lives sealed in an armoured, floating force chair with paired psycannons and a voice synthesiser. The withered body inside is described only in Ravenor Rogue.

evidence.claim: pre-injury: tall, handsome, long black hair pulled back in a ponytail, high cheekbones
tall, strong, well built, not quite as tall as Eisenhorn
whole body burned; confined to a life-supporting force chair with psycannons and voice synthesiser
body inside the chair shrivelled into a limbless sack (Ravenor Rogue)

appearance.summary: Tall (taller than Ravenor), clean-shaven and originally dark-haired. Locke's torture in Xenos left his face mostly paralysed so he cannot smile. After Hereticus he shaves his head for a crude augmetic rig that projects from the back of his skull and encases his legs, and he walks with a sword-stick. He wears sober dark grey or black suits under long blue or black high-collared coats, and carries the runestaff, Barbarisater and a sidearm. Juvenat treatments keep him looking roughly middle-aged; by the Bequin books he is a battered old man in powered leg braces.

evidence.claim: clean-shaven, dark-haired; shaved head for augmetic system
augmetic assist system projecting from back of head and encasing lower limbs; swordstick
facial nerves destroyed by Locke's torture; can no longer smile
sober dark grey/black suits under long blue or black high-collared coats
force staff topped with a skull lodestone; force sword Barbarisater; holstered sidearm
taller than Ravenor
heavily scarred; powered leg braces by The Magos; battered old man

appearance.summary: Tall, dark-haired and strikingly beautiful, although as a blank she unsettles people. Juvenat treatments and augmetic surgery keep her looking about thirty well past 125, with only crow's feet by Hereticus; she hates being seen in her half-moon reading spectacles. Her clone Beta Bequin, who looks almost exactly like her, is described as tall and slender with black hair and large dark eyes.

evidence.claim: tall, dark hair, very beautiful (Xenos ch.5)
clone Beta: tall, slender, black hair, large dark eyes; identical appearance
looks ~30 at 125 via juvenat/augmetic surgery; crow's feet by Hereticus; half-moon spectacles

appearance.summary: In Xenos, Quixos's host body is tall and muscular with a golden sheen to the skin, a handsome face, tiny stunted horns sprouting from the skull and blank eyes that blaze with evil white light. Eisenhorn later binds him with psychic amulets and fetters, first in a cloned host, then in Bastian Verveuk, briefly in an astropath, and finally in Godwyn Fischig's corpse. Unbound in Hereticus, he appears as a ball of white light.

evidence.claim: tall, muscular, golden sheen on skin, handsome face, tiny stunted horns, blank gaze (Xenos)
host's eyes radiate a white light
bound with countless psychic amulets and fetters; hosts: clone, Verveuk, astropath, Fischig's corpse
true form an unbound ball of white light (Hereticus)

appearance.summary: A tall, burly, fair-haired and clean-shaven Arbites chastener with a circular scar on one side of his face, usually in his dark-brown armoured Arbites uniform and visored helmet. After KCX-1288 he lost an arm, replaced with a metal bionic, and half his face, rebuilt with augmetic muscle and metal and covered by a white ceramite half-mask. After his death his corpse becomes Cherubael's host.

evidence.claim: tall and fair haired, physically imposing
tall, stocky, blond, clean-shaven, circular scar on one half of face; dark-brown armoured Arbites uniform and visored helmet
lost arm and half his face; metal bionic arm; white ceramite half-face mask
becomes host for Cherubael after death

appearance.summary: A very big, stocky former bounty hunter with a heavy skull, shaved head and neat goatee, brutish-looking but graceful. He usually wears a dull or dark close-fitting bodyglove under black flak or carapace armour. Juvenat treatments make him look about late thirties at over a hundred; in the Ravenor books he loses his left middle finger.

evidence.claim: very tall and stocky; head shaved bald except a neat goatee; dark tight one-piece combat suits; lost left middle finger
large man, heavy-looking skull, shaved head; dull bodyglove and black flak/carapace armour
over 100 but looks late thirties (juvenat); big, muscular

appearance.summary: A former acrobat and dancer, small, lithe and so well-muscled she looks almost stocky. She is curvy and often called a beauty, with very short red hair in Hereticus. In Ravenor she is seen in a cream skinsleeve with her red hair under a hood.

evidence.claim: small and lithe, very short red hair, muscular frame almost stocky (Hereticus)
small, flexible, muscular; very short red hair on Durer 386.M41
described as a beauty, athletic yet voluptuous
cream skinsleeve, red hair under a hood (Ravenor)

appearance.summary: Dark-skinned like all Glavians, with gold bio-circuitry wires woven into her hands. She wears the black, red-piped Glavian pilot's suit and her father's cerise, gold-embroidered flight jacket. In Pariah she is undercover as 'Sister Bismillah'.

evidence.claim: red-piped black Glavian pilot suit, father's cerise embroidered jacket; skin dark like all Glavians
dark skin; hands interwoven with gold wires; cherry-red gold-embroidered jacket
undercover as Sister Bismillah in Pariah

appearance.summary: A dark-skinned Glavian pilot, about Eisenhorn's height but lighter built, with unruly black curls framing a slender, usually mischievous face. Silver bio-circuitry is inset into his hands. He wears the red-piped black leather Glavian pilot suit with an embroidered cerise silk jacket and light gloves, and carries paired needle pistols.

evidence.claim: unruly black curls framing a dark-skinned, slender face (Xenos)
dark skinned, hands covered in inset Glavian bio-circuitry; red-piped black suit
same height as Eisenhorn but lighter build; silver wires in hands; cherry-red silk jacket; leather gloves
pair of needle pistols; expert shot with rifle

appearance.summary: In life he became corpulent with excess. For two centuries he survived only as an engram in a crystal, 'the Pontius'. In Hereticus Magos Bure builds him a tall, broad, human-shaped body of polished metal with a smiling golden face of the young Pontius and golden hair, the crystal set in its skull. It wears a cloak of overlapping knife-blades that he can fire, and extends blades from its fingers.

evidence.claim: became corpulent with excess
polished metal body, tall and broad; golden face of the young Pontius smiling and golden hair; crystal in skull; cloak of knife blades; finger blades
fires the blades of his cape by spinning

appearance.summary: By Malleus he is an ancient, filthy, misshapen horned monster with crimson eyes and cracked skin covered in sores and stigmata, kept alive by numerous augmetics. He still wears his Inquisitorial rosette and fights with the daemon sword Kharnagar, moving too fast to see. When he dies he crumbles to dust, leaving his empty armour and implants.

evidence.claim: misshapen, crimson-eyed horned monster; skin cracked, sores, stigmata; ancient, filthy; numerous augmetics; still wore rosette
rudimentary antlers; daemon sword Kharnagar; crumbles to dust leaving armour and implants

appearance.summary: A frail savant, already 278 in Xenos, with thin, liver-spotted skin and only a narrow crescent of white hair around the back of an otherwise bald head. His most distinctive feature is oversized augmetic eyewear. Extensive bionics and an augmetic exoskeleton hold up his body, and he is seen in sober green robes.

frail; relies on augmetic exoskeleton

killed aged 405 on Farness Beta

evidence.claim: a red-haired giant of a man

appearance.summary: A tall, fit, athletic radical with close-trimmed, tonsured black hair and shifty yellow eyes, styled like a warrior monk. He wears a tight weave-armour bodyglove in yellow-and-black check under a polished silver cuirass, and carries an ornate power sword and a laspistol. Hooded, robed acolytes and arco-flagellants attend him.

appearance.summary: A well-built, broad-shouldered Thorian with a blunt, pugnacious face and metal-grey hair. His lower jaw is a chrome prosthesis, fitted after a duel with a Khorne berserker. He wears copper-coloured power armour with ornate Malleus crests and purity seals, a wide white fur cloak and an Inquisition banner on his back, and fights one-handed with a power hammer.

appearance.summary: An Emperor's Children champion well over two metres tall, in heavily ornamented, blood-spattered power armour and a horned helm. Both are studded with gold and painted sulphur-yellow and violet, with disturbing hypnotic runes. A long cloak seems made of smoke and silk. His face is a white, powdered mask with a lipless mouth full of pearl-studded teeth and empty eyes ringed in gold and violet.

appearance.summary: Eisenhorn's contemporary and friend. The only described details are a large scar from a saurapt bite on Brontotaph (on his leg) and the saurapt tooth he wears on a necklace for the rest of his life.

appearance.summary: A powerfully built Rogue Trader whose age can't be judged from his looks, and an extravagant dresser: a purple coat with a black cravat, face powder, a sapphire beauty spot, a cap of spun silver, heavy signet rings (one a digital laser) and teeth set with mother-of-pearl. Las-fire in Xenos reveals that much of his lower body is mechanical, and his servitors rebuild it.

Their slave caste is bloated, with wrinkled, blotchy white skin.
